OQ-VI-03.summary: P1 first build uses the open-tube coaxial downstream ICP topology only; orificed RF plasma cathodes (Watanabe/Xu type) stay literature comparators / evidence / possible later branches and are not built in P1
OQ-VI-03.provision: the P1 carrier/interface stays modular so a future ICP_ORIFICED_VARIANT can be installed as an A9.x follow-on without redesigning H-1

OQ-VI-05.summary: perform the Ar 'no Hall discharge without ICP electrons' sequence (7 steps: H-1 gas/magnet set; C1 disconnected; ICP RF off; preregistered Hall start attempt inside registered limits; record sustained discharge or not; ICP on by registered procedure; observe sustainability); record V_d(t), I_d(t), I_e,ICP(t), P_RF,fwd(t), P_RF,refl(t), collector/reference potentials
OQ-VI-05.interpretation: not a PASS/FAIL gate; 'Hall must not run without ICP' is NOT preregistered as a physics requirement; an unexpected sustained discharge (facility electrons, SEE, residual plasma, other current path) is a finding requiring current-path diagnosis and does not by itself invalidate the ICP architecture; what must be demonstrated is that the ICP supplies the required electron current and neutralization function

OQ-A907-02.stand_ceiling: I_d,stand ceiling = 8.33 A (1500 W / 180 V), the laboratory supply/rating ceiling, for conductor sizing, current-sensor range, collector-circuit rating, feedthrough rating, protection, DAQ range, optional stress test; not evidence that H-1 requires 8.33 A
OQ-A907-02.icp45_requirement: I_e,required = I_d,max,H1 = maximum H-1 discharge current within the registered operating envelope relevant to the architecture, from measured/registered H-1 operation (not the supply rating); ICP-45 requires I_e,cap >= I_d,max,H1 with the preregistered one-sided uncertainty margin
OQ-A907-02.p1_before_freeze: progressive electron-current capability sweep; never PASS because 1 A, 2 A, ... is reached; report the surface I_e = f(P_RF, p, mdot, Z_ICP, V_collector) until the H-1 requirement is known
OQ-A907-02.flight_7p5A: 7.5 A (1350/180) may remain a power-envelope mathematical bound; not automatically the flight discharge-current requirement
OQ-A907-02.clarifies: the A9.1 ICP-45 reading 'from the registered H-1/discharge-supply envelope': the requirement is the registered H-1 maximum, the supply rating is only the stand ceiling

ICPQ-06.summary: any ICP gas line crossing a meaningful potential difference gets the Hall gas-isolator philosophy: ~1 kV DC development qualification at representative pressure, gas, geometry and feedthrough/isolator condition; check flashover, leakage, breakdown, surface tracking, repeated exposure where appropriate
ICPQ-06.qualification: no isolator in a gas line whose two ends are intentionally held at essentially the same floating potential; the requirement applies only where the plumbing bridges isolated potentials

OQ-RFQ-06.summary: mains-powered laboratory 13.56 MHz generator for P1, classified GROUND/FACILITY_ONLY; measure P_mains,in with a power analyzer (engineering quantity), P_RF,fwd, P_RF,refl and determine/cross-check delivered RF power
OQ-RFQ-06.boundary_rule: P_mains,in is never evidence for P_bus < 1.5 kW; the flight/system power question needs a later FLIGHT_REPRESENTATIVE_DC_RF_SOURCE with measured P_DC,in -> P_RF -> I_e
OQ-RFQ-06.p1_outputs: C_e = P_RF,delivered / I_e and preferably C_e,DC = P_generator,input / I_e, each with its exact boundary labelled

OQ-RFQ-07.summary: RFQ packages split by supplier speciality; the technical team/Claude prepares; commercial dispatch authority stays with P9E/Vyovrinda under Praveen's authorization; no automatic supplier contact

packages.RF: 13.56 MHz generator; directional coupler; forward/reflected sensors; local matching network components; RF coax; feedthroughs; dummy load; RF protection/interlocks
packages.gas_metrology: Ar/N2/O2/Xe MFCs; valves; pressure instrumentation; gas isolators; calibration
packages.vacuum_facility: chamber interfaces; pumping; feedthroughs; RGA/diagnostic interfaces
packages.hall_electrical: discharge supply; magnet supply; isolation; sensing
packages.mechanical_icp_fabrication: dielectric tube/chamber; RF antenna/coil; collector; carrier; machined supports
packages.thrust_metrology: stand; force calibration; DAQ; traceability hardware

OQ-RFQ-07.common_interface: a common top-level interface document keeps the separate packages compatible

OQ-RFQ-02.summary: the row-123 four-overlapping-range rule is not applied literally to Ar (engineering-only topology-reproduction gas); provide calibrated Ar flow to reproduce the neighbourhood of the Takahashi anchor (70 sccm ~ 2.1 mg/s, owner-stated), sweep above/below for ignition/current trends, with useful flow uncertainty in that window; one suitable Ar MFC if it covers the sweep, two overlapping ranges only if one cannot
OQ-RFQ-02.traceability: verify the Ar controller by the rate-of-rise/transfer calibration path; Ar data remain ENGINEERING_ONLY_NON_SCORING regardless of metrology quality; a later quantitative Ar programme needs a new metrology requirement
OQ-RFQ-02.amends: scope of owner row 123 for the Ar path only; atmospheric score-bearing paths keep four overlapping ranges

OQ-RFQ-10.summary: include the optional ICP dedicated-feed controller as an RFQ option line (G-ATM, G-XE, diagnostic gas injection); never bought/installed as part of the primary architecture merely because quoted; primary P1/A9 mode stays G-REUSE (Hall exhaust -> ICP, mdot_ICP,dedicated = 0); the physical capped ICP gas port remains
OQ-RFQ-10.booking: if G-XE/G-ATM is activated, mdot_ICP,dedicated is explicitly booked in the corresponding atmospheric/Xe ledger; a dedicated feed is a diagnostic variable and must not silently become the baseline
